event_text: Docomo confirms unauthorized access from outside to its online shop and My docomo
notes: Docomo's notice gives the date, not a time.

event_text: A mass-access alert flags the attack on My docomo
notes: ITmedia Mobile and CNET Japan, from the Nov 6 briefing.

event_text: Docomo stops procedures on the online shop and My docomo

time_text: Nov 5, 11 AM to Nov 6, 1:20 AM JST
event_text: Separate nationwide 5G SA service disruption; Docomo finds no sign of a cyberattack
Press reports say up to about 300,000 customer records leaked and that bank details were among the data
notes: Jiji Press and Nippon TV, both dated Nov 6.

event_text: My docomo procedures begin to resume gradually
Emergency maintenance begins on the My docomo iOS app
Docomo's 6th notice: usage, charges, d points and mail settings available again in My docomo
notes: The notice is as of this time.
